title: Survivorship Bias
coreMove: Detect when the survivors pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.
sourcePressure: The source sidecar and official source notes frame Survivorship Bias as a specific decision error around survivors, failed projects, graveyard. Traceable support includes Survivorship Bias and Mutual Fund Performance.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Survivorship Bias as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: detect when the survivors pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.

sourceAnchors.name: Survivorship Bias and Mutual Fund Performance
sourceAnchors.detail: Survivorship bias in funds and stock market indices, see: Edwin J. Elton, Martin J. Gruber & Christopher R. Blake, 'Survivorship Bias and Mutual Fund Performance', The Review of Financial Studies , volume 9, number 4, 1996, 1097-1120. Statistically relevant results by coincidence
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Survivorship Bias and Mutual Fund Performance can appear as a factual pressure point: the reader sees survivorship bias through evidence, not a decorative citation.
